notes.title: Not Another Dungeon?! turns 3!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
today marks 3 years since [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] was first released! A lot has happened in these 3 years, from Alexandrett's attempts to conquer the Tower of Imalsrith up to Kitai fighting to reunite his friends.

You can connect with developers and other adventurers on our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url]. We take your feedback very seriously, thank you again to everyone who has told us their opinion on [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]!

We want to thank you and all the other adventurers for another year of amazing support!

Behind the scenes, we are still working on our next title and are very excited to be able to tell you more next year (hopefully, fingers crossed!)! We still need a little more time, though.

See you soon, dear Adventurer!

[i]Best regards
Tim "Beatless", Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Small fixes | Update 3.0.6
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurer,
we're checking in for a short moment! There were some small issues we could not keep in the game. They mainly affected those who play [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] on low-end devices with a low framerate.

Bugfixes with this small update include:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the text display speed in the tutorial and upon starting the third dungeon for the first time would be limited to your framerate.
[*]Increased performance minimally.
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs.
[/list]

Found some more bugs? Let us know on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?!

P.S.: We are working hard on our next title and are eager to show you what this entails. We will be showing you the results of our work once we feel like it's ready. Thanks for your patience!
[/i]

notes.title: Not Another Dungeon?! turns 2!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
another year has passed and [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] officially turns 2 years old today, November 19th, 2023.

With the expansion [i]Glacial Bonds[/i], the game received its last expansion at the end of 2022. This year we were finally able to finish the revised tutorial after a long delay.

It fits better into the new landscape of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i], which has changed quite a bit since version 1.0.0 was released in 2021 - meisters, souls, blessings, the new action cards and ability system - many adventurers have requested a more detailed explanation. Along with a little more lore on our most important (and popular) characters, we've tried to include that in the new tutorial.

You can connect with developers and other adventurers on our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].

We want to thank you and all the other adventurers for another year of amazing support!

Even though there are currently no updates planned for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i], we are working hard behind the scenes on our next title. But we still need some time before we can show you more!

See you soon, dear adventurer!

[i]With kind regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: The Tutorial's here! | Update 3.0.4
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurer,
we are finally able to release the new tutorial with this update! New players should now be able to learn the game within these 6 short chapters, expanding the lore around Alexandrett, our protagonist, a little bit more!

This update includes:[list]
[*]Added the tutorial. Accompany Alexandrett on her way to the Tower of Imalsrith in this short adventure! (The tutorial panels which were displayed upon starting the game for the first time have been removed.)
[*]Fixed the cutscene playing before entering the Frozen Castle for the first time.
[*]The heroes from our collaboration with [i]Spell Of Darkness[/i] are now able to be bought with Soul Ashes.
[*]A few heroes had their voicelines re-recorded with another Voice Actor: Alice, Licht, Cim'Tame and Sympa.
[*]Fixed a bug where Alice's effect would trigger off of drawing a Guild.
[*]Fixed a few sound bugs within the pause menu.
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs.[/list]
Found some more bugs? Let us know on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].


[h3]Developer's Note[/h3]
[i]From now on, development for Not Another Dungeon?! will rest indefinitely. We are working hard on our next title and will need all of our resources for that.
We want to thank you all for your continuous support and love you showed for the game.

Thanks to your efforts, Alexandrett conquered the Tower of Imalsrith. You sealed the evil within the dark basement lurking beneath your feet. And finally, Alice, Kitai and Shiori are reunited after all those years.

Not Another Dungeon?! is a game about friendship and how working together can help you overcome the biggest obstacles in life.[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/923610318893121606/1128055189530738798/Unbenannt.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to show you what we've got in store! See you soon, dear Adventurer!

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Small Fixes | Update 3.0.3
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurer,
sorry for keeping you waiting for so long! Development on our next title is proceeding with full power, so we had no time to bring you a few new bugfixes until this moment, which are live now.

[i]Additional Note: We did notice that the tutorial is not working, but we need to postpone the fix of the tutorial a bit more. A few very impactful bugs appeared (due to version 3.0.0 being a bit more rushed than the other versions) and also a few voice lines are still missing. Although we can not say WHEN the tutorial will be fixed, we are working on it![/i]

Bugfixes with this small update include:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Draw Triggers of Ability Cards would not activate.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Guild would not transform into Reinforcements! when you played a guild for your last hero, but had more Guilds in your hand.
[*]Increased performance minimally.
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs.
[/list]

Found some more bugs? Let us know on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Small Fixes | Version 3.0.1
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
thanks for playing [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]. The latest content expansion had some minor bugs as well as some major bugs. We wanted to fix the minor bugs as soon as possible, so here they are! A seperate update for a few major bugs is coming as soon as possible!

This update contains the following bugfixes:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused individual game components such as blessings to not load properly. This had led to some consequential errors in the functionality of the menu.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented units from being defeated with STURDY in Chaos Mode if they had 1 max HP.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Elaney's finisher offset to be incorrect.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Kitai and Kalerym to talk to a conversation intended for Kitai and Shiori.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game not to continue if you paused the game and then tried to resume it.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some letters to not load properly.
[*]More small bug fixes.
[/list]

Found some more bugs? Let us know on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Here comes Version 3.0.0!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
it's finally here - [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]'s version 3.0.0 is finally available! This new content update adds the Frozen Castle as a new dungeon. Also, we have completely reprogrammed the core logic of the game to guarantee a more orderly flow in the game.
In the new booster series [i]"Glacial Bonds"[/i] more than 20 new heroes can be found, mainly heroes from the factions of the Empire of Fractile and the Golden Church. Of course there are also a bunch of new enemies and a few new Ability Cards! There is a lot new to discover!

Here's a little reminder to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url]! There, you can exchange ideas with other players and us developers! We look forward to any constructive feedback!

[hr][/hr]

[b]System:[/b][list]
[*]The core logic has been completely reworked. The game now registers in-game actions in a queue structure. Abilities like Thagnaek's or Trample now work properly, so can no longer target already defeated enemies.
[*]Added leaderboards for the Frozen Castle.
[*]The main menu has been completely restructured.
[*]The in-game user interface has been restructured.
[*]The inbox has been removed.
[*]The arcade panel now shows more information about each dungeon before you start. You can also quickly change your loadout there!
[*]The world map has been added to the main menu. Learn more about some important locations by clicking on the red markers!
[*]Daily login rewards have been added. You can find them on the left side of the main menu.
[*]Heroes, enemies, tokens and action cards can now be viewed in the collection. The details you can see about a unit in the collection have been expanded to include things like the levels the unit appears on or the action cards the unit adds.
[*]More filters have been added to the collection.
[*]The gallery has been added to the collection. There you can see the key visuals of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i].
[*]If you enter bonus codes or collect your daily reward, a banner will appear that clearly shows you what you have actually received. From there you can view cards directly in the collection.
[*]A new bonus series has been released. It includes 21 new heroes and is available in the store.
[*]4 new Blessings have been added. Unlock them by leveling up!
[*]10 new letters have been added to the store.
[*]8 new profile pictures have been added to the store. You unlock 2 new profile pictures through achievements.
[*]4 new card backs have been added to the store.
[*]4 new coin skins have been added to the store.
[*]50 new titles have been added to the store.
[*]The prices of the booster series have been adjusted.
[*]Added new achievements.
[*]Adjusted auto/random heal prioritization. Wounded units are targeted first, then units with OVERHEAL.
[*]Tokens no longer gain PUPPY PROTECTION when recruited.
[*]The requirements for meistering an enemy boss have been changed. It is no longer just the strongest boss on a level that can meister it.
[*]The event tasks of the "Full Steam Ahead" event are no longer available for new players. If you started the game in an earlier version, you keep the tasks.
[*]If you completed the tutorial in an earlier version, you will receive the heroine "Desteke, Scythe of Blackhorn" at the start.
[*]The tutorial has been revised, but is currently unavailable due to technical complications. New players are presented 14 panels summarizing each game option.
[*]Effects that would activate when a unit is last on its side now also activate when the unit is the only allied unit at floor start.
[*]Effects that would activate when defeating an enemy unit will no longer activate when defeating the last enemy in a floor.
[*]When a unit gains a shield, there now plays a short effect.
[*]And a lot more![/list]

[b]Heroes[/b][list]
[*][b][u]NEW:[/u][/b]Multiple Heroes. In order not to spoil you, they are not listed here.

[*]Anassai, Gambling's Musician: [i]AUTO now only works on targets that have not yet been defeated.[/i]
[*]Goltag, Warrior of the Ligen Valley: [i]Levels: [strike](5->8)[/strike] => (6->8)[/i]
[*]Lully, Dream Keeper: [i]In deck: [strike]Dark Chains, Dark Chains, Health Potion[/strike] => Night Strike, Night Strike, Health Potion[/i]
[*]Mirror, Shadow's Patriarch: [i]Levels: [strike](5->9)[/strike] => (6->9)[/i]
[*]Shapeshifter: [i]Fixed a bug where the card name would not update after the camouflage was blown.[/i][/list]

[b]New Ability Cards[/b][list]
[*]Night Strike
[*]Buffet Time
[*]Ultimate Sacrifice
[*]Golden Chalice
[*]Eternity Claw[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*]Achievement "You're not scaring me?!" works now.
[*]Achievement "The World?!" Triggers when a Waiting Time of 5 is reached, no longer a wait time of 4.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game could crash if your save data was too old.
[*]Fixed a bug that played a very loud sound when opening options for the first time.
[*]Fixed a bug where the letters cost 600 gold instead of the described 250 gold.
[*]Fixed some Link errors.
[*]More small bug fixes.[/list]

Best regards,
[i]Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Happy Birthday, Not Another Dungeon!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
wow. It's been a whole year since we released this little roguelite card game. [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] officially turns one year old today, on November 19th, 2022.

The game has changed over time, we've had multiple cross-overs and events, and drawn many, [b]many[/b] card sprites. Numerous people have attempted Tower of Imalsrith!

But enough of the past. [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] will receive its next major update on December 3rd. So we're not done yet. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1739100/view/5787716373046326419]Click here to read more about it.[/url]

We would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who made this project possible. We would like to thank the Voice Actors who recorded their first role with us, as well as the old hands who have been with us for years. And we want to thank you, who added the game to their library and maybe spent a nice few hours with it.

Finally, as project and studio manager, I would like to say a special thank you to my team. Couldn't have done it without you!

Please keep enjoying [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]!

[i]Best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Preparing for the third round | Version 3.0.0 releases December 3rd!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
after some time, the date for the next big update has finally been set! Thanks to all of your feedback, we can make [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] a better experience for everyone. Although we probably overshot the mark a little bit, because we (again) recoded a good chunk of the entire game.

If you have feedback or feel that any of the changes aren't right for the game, feel free to let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord Server[/url].

[h3]The Factions' Identities[/h3]
Until now, factions haven't really defined the style of their cards' effects - we aim to change that with modified and new effects. The individual factions get their own face - so if you like big card synergies, for example, you will find joy in the units of the Empire of Fractile.

[h3]The User Interface[/h3]
The User Interface has irritated many players, which is why we have completely redesigned the main menu and other menus. Your inbox disappears, the quests have been restructured again.

[h3]The Backstories[/h3]
We felt it was the right idea to keep the backstories of each character very much in the background so far. Outside of the tutorial, you can still pretty much ignore these if you're only interested in gameplay. Since the interest in the background stories, especially Alice's, was greater than initially thought, we have tried to bring you the background details a little closer - there is a new submenu in the menu for this purpose, which shows a map of Ursus, the continent, as well as some important places there. We added more meetup lines (conversations that happen when two specific characters meet). Also, certain actions trigger short sections of the storytelling. Don't worry, these can also be skipped by the press of a button.

[h3]The Tutorial[/h3]
[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] isn't as one-dimensional as it was a year ago (back then there were no Blessings, far fewer Ability Cards, and Alice was the only unit that could meister!). Many players still don't know what to do with souls. That's why we revised the tutorial and divided it into several small chunks. We also want to bring out the backstories of the characters a bit more. As a reward for completing all tutorial chapters, you'll get a powerful new hero with a brand new type of status effect! So it's also worth playing the new tutorial as a returning player!

[h3]The Structure[/h3]
So far, everything in the logic of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] has taken place pretty much at the same time (we don't even want to start with the coin toss at this point), but that damages the clarity. That's why we reprogrammed a large part of the gameplay to make the game more performant and above all more structured: There are now dedicated time slots for (almost) every action. Once again we rely on your feedback!

Like last time, the new update includes a lot of new content, such as a new booster pack with 21 new heroes, many new collectibles and a brand new dungeon. There are also 3 new status effects, 5 new action cards, daily login rewards and much more! I don't want to get too specific here, you'll have to wait for the update itself to find out exactly what's new.

As compensation for the long wait, there will be also 1 free booster pack of the first expansion, "Wings Of A New Beginning", for everyone*! This booster pack contains a lot of powerful units for the later levels, which is especially valuable at the beginning of the game, since the starter deck doesn't contain that many units for the later levels!
[i]*You will automatically receive the booster pack when you start version 3.0.0.[/i]

[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] will release its version 3.0.0 on December 3rd, 2022. From 10:00 a.m. CST / 04.00 a.m. EST there will also be a stream on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739100/Not_Another_Dungeon]Steam page[/url] and our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/daggerbunnystudios]Twitch channel[/url], hosted by SakuraiVA!

If you have feedback or just want to talk to other players and us developers, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]discord server[/url].

[i]Best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: The Lords Of Steam are here! | Time-limited event: Full Steam Ahead
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
we are excited to announce our second time-limited event!

Together with a few minor balance changes and bug fixes, we're introducing 4 new event heroes to [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] - The Lords Of Steam. With their brand new technology, the [b][i]Steam Generator TX-41[/i][/b], they are able to summon powerful Steamcloud Beasts, and, if the circumstances are right, the powerful boss hero "Nimbus, Uppermost Lord Of Steam"! The new [b]LINK[/b] system allows for cards to link themselves to other units, in order to get access to more powerful effects! Only 2 cards are using this system right now [i](one of which is an event card you can unlock right now)[/i], but we're looking forward to adding more of them in the future!

Start [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] from [b]June 1st 2022 - August 31st 2022[/b] to receive four (4) new, time-limited quests with which, after completing them, you can unlock four (4) new heroes and one (1) new profile icon from this event, [b][i]Full Steam Ahead[/i][/b]!

We also added one new hidden achievement. Can you find out what you need to do to unlock it?

You can obtain the following heroes:
[list]
[*]Cirrus, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Mieh, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Stratus, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Tyndall, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Lully, Dreamkeeper - Bonus Code "LULLY"
[*]Krystix, Nightshade - Bonus Code "KRYSTIX"
[/list]

Also, a new enemy has been added to the Tower's Basement:
[list]
[*]Scrap Soldier
[/list]

And two new tokens have been added. The Lords Of Steam use them!
[list]
[*]Steamcloud Beast
[*]Nimbus, Uppermost Lord Of Steam
[/list]

We also adjusted the balance of a few Ability Cards:
[list]
[*]Misfire: Removed x2 damage multiplicator
[*]Breakwater: Added x2 damage multiplicator
[/list]

And, finally, a few minor bugs were fixed:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Para, Iyu, Ken and Ashe would not be added to your collection after completing their quests. When you start [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] the next time, they will be automatically added to your collection.
[*]Fixed a bug where event quests would not be displayed in the small quest lists.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game could would be stuck in the hero selector upon Alexandrett being defeated, but no heroes being available to recruit.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes card details would still be visible after the cursor being set invisible or the time being paused.
[*]Fixed a bug with the quest check not working as intended.
[*]Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]

Starting the game in the said timespan will add the event quests to your quest list on startup. Once redeemed, the quests are here to stay. So make sure to get them while they are here!

The new Ability Card system as well as the other reworked mechanics seem to be a good addition accoding to your wonderful feedback. Thanks for that! We're working hard on making [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] a more enjoyable experience with each update.

We now start working on version 3.0.0, which includes a new dungeon [i](some say some hints can be found within the collectable letters)[/i], a new booster pack and more! For more information, please stay tuned!

[i]With steam-filled regards,
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?!

P.S.: Join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord Server[/url] to interact with the developers and other players![/i]

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 is finally here!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
it took a bit longer than expected, but version 2.0.0 of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is finally available! As the first full content update, the Tower's Basement is added as a new dungeon, and the Ability Card System and the Unit Card Ability system have been completely reworked. Of course there are also new heroes (over 20 in the new booster series [i]"What Lies Beneath"[/i]) and new enemies. The goal of this update was to bring more in-depth mechanics to the game without throwing away [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]'s casual approach. There is a lot new to discover! For the tryhard players among you, we've added new analysis tools to the game.

Here's a little reminder to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url]! There you can exchange ideas with other players and us developers! We look forward to any constructive feedback!

[hr][/hr]

[b]System:[/b][list]
[*]The whole game is now no longer on the UI layer. This should increase performance significantly.
[*]The save data has been adjusted. It will be automatically migrated and selected by Steam Cloud Save. You won't lose any data. However, reverting to earlier versions is not possible.
[*]Added blessings. These abilities have charges and can be used like an additional Ability Card. New blessings can be unlocked as you level up.
[*]Added shields. These serve as temporary extra HP.
[*]The card layouts for units and Ability Cards have been adjusted.
[*]Added coin toss. Some new cards use this mechanic.
[*]Added leaderboards for the Tower's Basement.
[*]Leaderboards now always show your rank instead of 6th place.
[*]Unlocked heroes are now greyed out in the collection.
[*]Duplicate boosters now drop Soul Ashes instead of Gold (based on their rarity level). Soul Ashes can be used to craft heroes that have not yet been unlocked.
[*]Locked heroes now have an unlock notice in the collection.
[*]The UNLOCKS button in the main menu has been removed. Instead, there are now buttons to go to the collection and shop directly.
[*]A new booster series has been released. It includes 21 new heroes and is available in the store.
[*]10 new letters have been added to the store.
[*]9 new profile pictures have been added to the store.
[*]The options have been reworked and expanded.
[*]The game is now significantly louder.
[*]Adjusted some UI elements in the main menu.
[*]The in-game UI has been adjusted. In addition to mouse, UI and gameplay hints, the UI has been streamlined.
[*]Instead of the large box when right-clicking, card details are now shown when you mouse over them. Further details (e.g. scaling values ​​or status effects) can be called up by right-clicking.
[*]Your turn no longer ends automatically if you could still master or use your blessing.
[*]Units now also have an affinity (an element). Some cards use this.
[*]Added more loading screen hints.
[*]Added new achievements.
[*]The camera work has been improved.
[*]The event quests of the event "Call Of Zefral" (Miriel Saga) are no longer available for new players. If you started the game in an earlier version, you keep the quests.
[*]The faction, class, and rarity [i](and many more!)[/i] icons have been adjusted.
[*]The loading times (especially in the collection) have been reduced.
[*]The performance has been improved.
[*]The tutorial has been adjusted.
[*]And a lot more![/list]

[b]Player:[/b][list]
[*]Profile customization, stats, quests, and inbox have been merged.
[*]The statistics have been adjusted. There's a lot more detail there now.
[*]In the collection, 1 card can be designated as a favorite card. This is displayed in the profile view in the statistics.
[*]Added event tokens. With 1 event token you can buy any item from the shop. These tokens are rare and will be given out during limited-time events.
[*]Added Soul Ashes. They can be used to craft heroes that have not yet been unlocked.
[*]Titles added. They are unlockable in the shop and through quests.
[*]Added card backs. They are available in shop.
[*]Added coin skins. They are available in shop.[/list]

[b]High score calculation[/b][list]
[*]Score for recruiting: [i][strike]+200[/strike] => +250 points (There are no points if a hero is replaced)[/i]
[*]Score for defeating a normal opponent: [i][strike]+300[/strike] => +350 points[/i]
[*]Score for a [i]"Perfect Kill"[/i] (bring an enemy unit to exactly 0 HP): [i][strike]+250[/strike] => +275 points[/i]
[*]Score for entering a new level: [i][strike]+300[/strike] => +400 points[/i]
[*]Score for defeating Irel'la: [i][strike]+600[/strike] => +700 points[/i]
[*]Score for defeating Leo'polio: [i][strike]+650[/strike] => +750 points[/i]
[*]Score for defeating Mag'cha: [i][strike]+750[/strike] => +850 points[/i]
[*]Score for defeating Aphradim: [i][strike]+900[/strike] => +975 points[/i][/list]

[b]Heroes[/b][list]
[*][b][u]NEW:[/u][/b] Multiple Heroes. In order not to spoil you, they are not listed here.

[*]Alice, Shine's Sovereign: [i]AUTO 1 changed to status effect (growth)[/i]
[*]Bahim, Autumn's Petal: [i]AUTO changed to status effect (hurry)[/i]
[*]Cim'tame, Hand of the Crypt: [i]Planes: [strike](2->4)[/strike] => (1->4), AUTO added: "Cannot be defeated by Och' mie'tahl's effect."[/i]
[*]Hemi, Spy for Hire: [i]AUTO removed[/i]
[*]Kamina, Hero of the Plateau: [i][strike]AUTO[/strike] => Inspirational 1, Banner (Infantry)[/i]
[*]Kassandra, Healer of the Golden Church: [i]Portrait and voiceover adjusted[/i]
[*]Light, Instructor of Kings: [i][strike]AUTO[/strike] => Holy 5[/i]
[*]Picarus, The Thieving Magpie: [i]AUTO removed[/i]
[*]Sympa, Druid of the Mei'ka: [i]Planes: [strike](1->5)[/strike] => (1->4)[/i]
[*]Thagnaek, Ally of Steve: [i]Portrait adjusted[/i]
[*]Yeramias, Lightborne: [i]AUTO removed[/i]
[*]Grimm, The Judge: [i]AUTO changed: "When this unit recruits or enters a new level: Recruit 2 Grimm's minion tokens."[/i]
[*]Nomi the Turtle: [i][strike]AUTO[/strike] => Armored, Sturdy, Thorns 4[/i]
[*]Seki, BEdAM Researcher: [i]Planes: [strike](3->6)[/strike] => (4->7)[/i][/list]

[b]Reworked action cards[/b][list]
[*]Guild: Transforms into [i]Replenishment![/i] if you could not recruit new heroes.
[*]Chains Of Heaven: Can be activated without Sato.
[*]Eagle's Eye: Can be activated without Fey.
[*]Razerblade: Can be activated without Alex.
[*]Sail Strike: Can be activated without Adler. Damage now scales (1->4).
[*]Banners: Now give the Banner status effect. Can no longer be stacked. The buff strength scales.
[*]Unrestrained Slash: Damage now scales (1->7).

notes.title: Getting ready for the second round | Version 2.0.0 releases May 1st!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
we received a lot of really valueable feedback. Thanks for that! In this event post, I'll be talking a bit about what some of the most common things were the players did not like about the game and how we are approaching on changing them for the better. We recoded a good chunk of the entire game, too.

If you want to give us your feedback or think that one of the changes is not doing the right thing for the game, feel free to tell us on our Discord Server.

[h3]Gameplay Depth[/h3]
[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is a casual experience. Some would say, it's gameplay is flat. A lot of things do not have any meaningful impact. We want to change that, but not forget the simplistic approach which makes [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]. We simply want to add more to discover. And by that, we mean a [b]lot[/b] more to discover. We really like the "easy to learn, hard to master" aspect of our game and by adding a lot more of diversity and [i]bit[/i] more of complexity, we aim to make [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] a better experience for both casual and tryhard gamers.

[h3]The Ability Card System[/h3]
The by far worst-received feature of the current state of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is the Ability Card System - The cards on your hand which you draw from your deck. They simply have almost no impact right now - except for the Guild, which is, and is for all times going to be, the key to our gameplay. We just wanted the other Ability Cards to feel more diverse and impactful. While the old cards were mostly small tools to help the player perfecting enemies (bringing them to exactly 0 health to gain bonus points), we wanted to rework that entire system. Not only did we add a lot of more Ability Cards, we also introduced a whole lot of new mechanics (like Shields and Status Effects) which they bring to the table as well as a system to keep early-game cards relevant until the end: Scaling. Cards like Quick Punch will not deal 1 damage, but instead 1->5, which means that the strength of the card increases while progressing through the dungeon. This, combined with the less cards a new hero adds to your deck, should make for some more strategic, diverse and fun runs.

[h3]Abilities[/h3]
We simply changed or removed any abilites from units that we thought have no impact on the game at all. Abilities used multiple times were put into so-called "Status Effects", which can be seen on the bottom of the card. Those keywords replace the buffs, such as Puppy Protection and the Banners. Units that you receive later in the game have more complex effects than those you start with, although we try to keep the card effects as simple as possible.

[h3]Quality Of Life[/h3]
"Why do I have to choose a target for every single Ability Card, even if it does not have any effect on the selected unit?" - We are changing that. Instead of dragging all Ability Cards on a target, we changed it so you drag the card you want to use in the center of the screen and then select your target(s) (yes, we do have a few new Ability Cards which require more than one target). Although this takes a bit of time to get used to, we found this approach to be a lot less frustrating and clear than the old one. We are still thinking about adding an option to revert to the old system, but this is really unlikely.

Of course, we are also adding a lot of new content, such as a new Booster Pack with 21 new heroes, a few new collectables and a brand-new dungeon into the game. I don't want to get too specific here, you'll have to wait for the update itself to find out what exactly is new. 

[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] will release it's version 2.0.0 May 1st, 2022.

If you have any feedback or just want to talk to other players and us developers, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord-Server[/url].

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Thank you for this 2021!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
as 2021 is slowly coming to an end, we would like to review the year 2021 from a developer's and player's perspective.

[h3]What happened? | Milestones[/h3]
[list]
[*]August 2021: The Steam page for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is released to the public.
[*]October 29th 2021: The release date for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is announced: November 19th!
[*]November 19th 2021: [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is finally released in Version 1.0.0. [url=https: //twitter.com/SakuraiVA]SakuraiVA[/url] streams the game on our Steam site.
[*]November 2021: [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] receives its first bug fix patches.
[*]December 1st 2021: The first medium-sized update for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is released. In addition to a revision of the high score system, [url=https: //twitter.com/SakuraiVA]SakuraiVA[/url] receives his own card.[/list]

[h3]Developer's View[/h3]
Even if [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] has not even been released for a whole month by the time we write this, we would like to say a big thank you to all of you. You made this a wonderful year for us developers. It might not seem like it to gamers, but every download, review, and comment made our day better. We didn't expect such a small project to have such a great community.
Whether it's Alex, our Lead Writer, who is really happy about the slightest increase in the number of players, or Tarik, our Lead Composer, who can't really understand the praise for his fantastic soundtrack - we're really grateful for everyone who enjoys this adventure with us.
That gives us the incentive to work at full speed on new content for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]. We really look forward to bringing you more content in the not too distant future!

[i]"The release went better than we could even have imagined. We thank you all for your positive feedback." - Alexander "Archangel" H., Lead Writer of Not Another Dungeon?![/i] 

[h3]Player' View[/h3]
[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] had two larger, closed beta tests prior to release, which were mostly attended by the Voice Actors and some of our friends.
After the first, longer test phase in June 2021, a lot of feedback had really built up, but we had all worked through until the second, shorter test phase in August. It wasn't a little work, but it was definitely worth the effort.
Minor rivalries have formed on the leaderboards. Content creators have created content on different platforms. It's almost a bit surreal.

[i]"I always found the collaboration to be very pleasant and I love to see how much the community's opinion is taken into account both before the release during the beta phase and after the release." - Brian "Titankämpfer" R., Tester and Voice Actor of Para [/i] 

[h3]Finally[/h3]
Thank you so much for this fantastic year. We thank everyone who helped us, all Voice Actors, all players and of course you for reading this article! We hope 2022 will be even better! We will do our utmost to achieve this.

With best regards
[i]Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?!

P.S.: We can't wait to send you information about version 2.0.0! Stay tuned![/i]

notes.title: Gameplay Adjustments and Balance Changes | Patchnotes Version 1.1.0

[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
this month we'd like to make some major adjustments to the game.
Among other things, these changes prevent the boring high-score strategy of [i]"Guildinizing"[/i] (Defeating all opponents on the level except for one weak opponent and then wait until you have played all guilds from your deck - Recruiting always gave a lot of points). We also tried to make the game more enjoyable. Bosses should now feel more like bosses and less like plain noise.

Dear Adventurer,
it is time. Grab your sword and buckle up for this new adventure. [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is now available for download - [b]completely free.[/b]

Conquer 10 randomly generated levels and make the demonic Tower of Imalsrith yours! Fight evil demons and their king Aphradim to bring home the glory! Make new friends along the way! Cleverly combining cards is the key to victory.

notes.title: Not Another Dungeon?! releases November 19th!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,
finally, we are proud to announce the release of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]. It has been quite a long journey since we started development on this [i]"small"[/i] game two years ago.

[b][i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] will start its Version 1.0.0 release on November 19th 2021, 10 AM UTC+2.[/b]

We had the fantastic opportunity to get in contact with testers and enthusiastic card players from all around the world. And we want to thank every single one of you for that. Although we are a very small studio, we created a wonderful, breathing world and characters that people can identify as and cheer for - not least because of the fantastic voice over by the amazing voice actors we were allowed to meet on our way. We worked hard and we are proud how [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] turned out. And in the end, we wish for you to have fun with the game and maybe - just maybe - accompany us on our journey.

But the release is not the end! We are already working on the first expansion for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] which is currently named [i]"Not Another Dungeon?! : What lies beneath"[/i] (subject to be changed). We hope you look forward to us giving further information on this topic in early 2022.

Until then, good luck, dear Adventurers! Show those demons who's the boss!

With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]
